units.function: Intended PostgreSQL tests for revision-safe annotation creation, linked-comment cleanup, bounded review context and same-issue confirmation/wake projection.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> document annotation/document/plan-review/heartbeat services -> real Paperclip DB schema and embedded PostgreSQL when supported; no route authorization, Identity, legal retention or renderer.
units.keyDataModels: Document/revision, annotation thread/comment/anchor snapshot, issue comment link, issue interaction target/result, review context limits and structured wake annotation deltas.
units.lifecycle: Create thread against exact revision -> persist anchored review comments -> build bounded Agent context -> confirmations bind to same document revision -> later source-comment deletion removes linked comments and may resolve empty thread.
units.testAssessment: All 11 tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs, so none of the database concurrency/atomicity claims is executed evidence here. The intended transaction race, context bounds and cross-issue rejection are strong; anchor remap, tenancy, content safety, idempotency and retention semantics remain untested.
units.designRationale: Keep review anchors consistent under concurrent document edits, prevent stale/cross-task feedback injection and send bounded exact revision feedback to Agents.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs immutable evidence review where human/Agent annotations remain tied to exact evidence revisions and responsibility decisions while context delivered to Agents is bounded, classified and tenant-safe.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the transactional revision guard, exact confirmation target, cross-issue fail-closed behavior and bounded context accounting. Replace physical deletion with tombstone/legal-hold retention; add content hashes, author identity/responsibility, tenant checks, anchor-remap ambiguity handling, sanitization/classification and idempotent versioned resolve/reopen commands. Only include review content in Connector prompts under explicit data/tool policy.
units.responsibilityConflict: Physically deleting linked annotation comments erases review evidence and authorship from the responsibility chain. Confirmation context binds a revision well but does not bind the full Work/Agent/permissions/data/approval/evidence/result contract or an accountable human eligibility decision.

units.securityFindings: CRITICAL verification gap: all 11 persistence/concurrency tests skipped. HIGH evidence-destruction conflict: cleanup physically deletes annotation comments when a linked issue comment is deleted, with no tombstone/legal hold/retention certificate. HIGH prompt/data risk: annotation bodies enter wake payloads; tests cover length truncation but not classification, redaction, prompt injection or data-export policy. HIGH tenant/identity gap: cross-issue cases exist, but cross-company IDs, author membership and resolver authority are not tested. Missing anchor-remap ambiguity, Unicode selector, XSS/markdown, idempotency and concurrent resolve/reopen cases.
